summary: Mynd.ai, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes balance sheets, income statements, and equity changes, referencing a related-party inventory management and consultancy agreement dated January 14, 2026. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, providing financial updates without transactional elements. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories.
